instruction: Create a new layer group and name it 'Shapes'.

metadata.explanation: Task requires creating a new layer group named 'Shapes' in GIMP. Evaluator parses the XCF file to extract layer structure and verifies that a layer group named 'Shapes' exists in the image.

Complete coverage: Instruction requires creating a layer group named 'Shapes', and evaluator checks exactly this requirement
Proper expected value handling: Metric correctly accesses expected.get('name') directly without the expected.get('rules') anti-pattern
